caption: The drawing shows the shape of a fish depicted in a side profile facing left. The fish is rendered using a brown wood texture, with visible grain and knots, filling the entire body of the fish including the fins and tail, creating a silhouette effect. The fish features two pectoral fins, a dorsal fin, a ventral fin, and a notched tail fin, all rendered in the same wooden appearance as the body. The background is a plain, light beige color with a smooth texture, devoid of any patterns or details. There is a small, cursive handwritten signature in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Weather Vane
